name: Ennedi Massif: Natural and Cultural Landscape
description: In the Sahara of northeastern Chad, the Ennedi Massif is a sandstone plateau that wind and water have carved into deep canyons, towering cliffs, natural arches and rock spires. Permanent pools in the biggest gorges sustain wildlife and herders' camels. Caves and rock shelters hold thousands of paintings and engravings, many showing cattle, made up to 7,000 years ago.
